name: sync_purchase
description: Syncs a purchase record. Returns existing if found, creates new if not.

input.name: child_id
input.description: The ID of the child associated with the purchase

input.name: journey_id
input.description: The ID of the journey associated with the purchase

input.name: purchase_source
input.description: The source or platform where the purchase was made

input.name: purchase_reference
input.description: A unique reference identifier for the purchase
